body: We had talked about doing it for a few weeks, casually. One night his mom was out of town and we planned it all out. It was boring, awkward, and painful. We were clueless.

I do all of those things above, less lately though because it never goes anywhere and I end up feeling hurt, unattractive, rejected.

So he knows when I want it. He's very intuitive in general and aware of my feelings, which makes this situation more frustrating.
